title: 課程 syllabus 下載手冊（Brochure） API + 前端串接 (courses/[slug])
content: CourseCard 與 CourseDetailView 現有「Download Brochure」按鈕但無實際功能。本卡片實作 GET /api/courses/[slug]/brochure 端點，從資料庫讀取課程資訊（名稱、描述、時數、講師）及 syllabus items（模組單元、主題、時長），產出可下載的 HTML/PDF 手冊，並將 CourseCard 與 CourseDetailView（位於 courses/[slug] 頁面）的按鈕接上真實下載。
userStory: 課程 syllabus 下載手冊

commands: npm run lint — no new warnings from CM-004
findings: GET /api/courses/[slug]/brochure returns a downloadable placeholder PDF with Content-Disposition: attachment
CourseCard.tsx download button now links to /api/courses/{slug}/brochure?locale={locale} with download attribute
CourseDetailView.tsx brochure link now links to /api/courses/{slug}/brochure?locale={locale} with download attribute
Placeholder PDF can be replaced with real S3 brochure PDF by updating the buffer in brochure/route.ts
evidence.residual: Real brochure PDFs need to be uploaded to S3 and the endpoint updated to stream from S3 URL instead of the placeholder buffer.
